subject: Websocket connection getting interrupted after implementing javascript image download button

messages.author: c8ecb80eea7d9eef
messages.subject: Websocket connection getting interrupted after implementing javascript image download button
parts:
I use rCharts to create plots in my Shiny application. To allow the users download the charts, I have added a download button in my application. I use canvg and canvas2image javascript libraries to convert the SVG to PNG and download it.

This is the javascript function which I call when the download button is clicked.

function download()
{
    console.log("hi");
   // var svg = $('svg').parent().html();
    var svg = document.getElementById("summary").getElementsByTagName("svg")[0];
    var svgData = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString( svg );
    canvg('canvas', svgData );
    canvas = document.getElementById("canvas")
    saveCanvas(canvas,"PNG")
    console.log("hii");
}

function saveCanvas(pCanvas, strType) {
        var bRes = false;
        if (strType == "PNG")
            bRes = Canvas2Image.saveAsPNG(pCanvas);
        if (strType == "BMP")
            bRes = Canvas2Image.saveAsBMP(pCanvas);
        if (strType == "JPEG")
            bRes = Canvas2Image.saveAsJPEG(pCanvas);

        if (!bRes) {
            alert("Sorry, this browser is not capable of saving " + strType + " files!");
            return false;
        }
    }

When I click on the button, shiny application gets grayed out and I get the following error

The connection to ws://node1.com:3838/app/__sockjs__/430/qc26omfm/websocket was interrupted while the page was loading.
sockjs-0.3.min.js
Line 27

But image gets downloaded correctly.

Any idea how to fix this? Thanks for your inputs.

Regards,
Anand
